def get_grad_norm_arr(net, inputs, targets, loss_fn, split_data=1, skip_grad=False):
    net.zero_grad()
    N = inputs.shape[0]
    grad_norm_arr = []
    for sp in range(split_data):
        st = sp * N // split_data
        en = (sp + 1) * N // split_data

        outputs = net.forward(inputs[st:en])
        if isinstance(outputs, tuple) and len(outputs) == 2:
            outputs = outputs[1]
        if isinstance(net, Model):
            outputs, aux_logits = outputs[0], outputs[1]
        loss = loss_fn(outputs, targets[st:en])
        loss.backward()

        grad_norm_arr.append(get_layer_metric_array(net, lambda l: l.weight.grad.norm() if l.weight.grad is not None else torch.zeros_like(l.weight), mode='param'))

    return grad_norm_arr
